CREATE TABLE "product_change_queue" (
  "id" TEXT DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))) NOT NULL,
  "row_key" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "write" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "before" TEXT,
  "after" TEXT,
  "state" TEXT DEFAULT 'ready' NOT NULL,
  "attempts" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "due_at" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
  "claim_expires_at" TEXT,
  "claim_token" TEXT,
  "last_error" TEXT,
  "created_at" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "product_timers_deadlines" (
  "id" TEXT DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))) NOT NULL,
  "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "due_at" TEXT,
  "fired" INTEGER,
  "fired_at" TEXT,
  "outcome" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("product_id") REFERENCES "product" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

statements: CREATE TRIGGER "trg_product_bump_version" AFTER UPDATE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW._version = OLD._version BEGIN UPDATE "product" SET _version = OLD._version + 1 WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_product_changes_delete" AFTER DELETE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "product_change_queue" ("row_key", "write", "at", "before", "after")
  VALUES (OLD."id", 'delete', (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(substr(strftime('%f', 'now'), 4) AS INTEGER)), json_object('title', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."title") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."title") ELSE OLD."title" END, 'price', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."price") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."price") ELSE OLD."price" END), NULL);
END
steps.subject: trigger/product/trg_product_changes_delete

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_product_changes_insert" AFTER INSERT ON "product" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "product_change_queue" ("row_key", "write", "at", "before", "after")
  VALUES (NEW."id", 'insert', (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(substr(strftime('%f', 'now'), 4) AS INTEGER)), NULL, json_object('title', CASE WHEN typeof(NEW."title") = 'blob' THEN hex(NEW."title") ELSE NEW."title" END, 'price', CASE WHEN typeof(NEW."price") = 'blob' THEN hex(NEW."price") ELSE NEW."price" END));
END
steps.subject: trigger/product/trg_product_changes_insert

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_product_changes_update" AFTER UPDATE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN OLD."title" IS NOT NEW."title" OR OLD."price" IS NOT NEW."price"
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "product_change_queue" ("row_key", "write", "at", "before", "after")
  VALUES (NEW."id", 'update', (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(substr(strftime('%f', 'now'), 4) AS INTEGER)), json_object('title', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."title") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."title") ELSE OLD."title" END, 'price', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."price") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."price") ELSE OLD."price" END), json_object('title', CASE WHEN typeof(NEW."title") = 'blob' THEN hex(NEW."title") ELSE NEW."title" END, 'price', CASE WHEN typeof(NEW."price") = 'blob' THEN hex(NEW."price") ELSE NEW."price" END));
END
steps.subject: trigger/product/trg_product_changes_update
